description.zh: 企业版实例的实例ID。您可在物联网平台控制台的**实例概览**页面，查看当前实例的**ID**。
description.en: The ID of the Enterprise Edition instance. You can view the **ID** of the instance on the **Overview** page in the IoT Platform console.

description.zh:
License类型（音视频规格），可取值：**480P**、**720P**。

您可在**音视频通信服务**控制台的**License管理>产品授权**页面，查看目标产品的License类型。
description.en:
The license type that specifies the audio and video specifications. Valid values: **480P** and **720P**.

To view the license type of a product, choose **License Management > Product Authorization** in the **Real-time Communication Service** console.

description.zh:
待取消授权的产品的ProductKey。

您可在**音视频通信服务**控制台的**License管理>产品授权**页面，查看目标产品的**Product Key**。
description.en:
The ProductKey of the product from which you want to unbind the license.

You can choose **License Management > Product Authorization** in the **Real-Time Communication Service** console to view the **ProductKey** of the product.

descriptions.zh:
## 使用说明
已为目标产品授权过License。具体操作，请参见[BindLicenseProduct](~~427956~~)或[产品授权](~~427937~~)。


## QPS限制

单个阿里云账号调用该接口的每秒请求数（QPS）最大限制为10。

> RAM用户共享阿里云账号配额。
descriptions.en:
## Usage notes

A license is bound with a product. For more information, see [BindLicenseProduct](~~427956~~) or [Bind a license to a product](~~427937~~).

## QPS limits

You can call this API operation up to 10 times per second per account.

> The RAM users of an Alibaba Cloud account share the quota of the account.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun iot unbind-license-product --iot-instance-id iot-s3000 --license-code 480P --product-key gq62z000 --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
